corrections.reason: The word split across L31-L32 is ስምሁን ('Your name'), and the image clearly shows the second-order horizontal stroke on ሁ.
Classical Ge'ez preposition በ with 3rd person masculine plural suffix is ቦሙ ('in them', John 17:26), matching the shortened left leg of 7th-order ቦ on the page.
The image at the end of Col 2 L19 shows እንዲ (continuing onto L20 as ህ to form እንዲህ አለ), not እንደዚ.
Canonical Ge'ez of John 18:3 is ወዓዕደኒሆሙ ('and their officers/attendants', glossed in Amharic as ብላቴኖቻቸውን), and the image clearly shows the triangular 6th-order ዕ rather than ል.
